ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity black pigmentation along the distal boundaries and basal insertion point.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial regions consist of a contiguous white field. Black pigmentation is localized to a thin perimeter along the trailing edge, widening significantly at the distal tips. The fluke base features a black semi-circular region with a sharp white 'V' shaped indentation at the center-line.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch; internal angle measured at approximately 115 degrees; notch depth is approximately 1/10th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits fine-scale, high-frequency serrations (1-3 pixel amplitude) along the continuous boundary. Macro-level irregular bumps are visible at the terminal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a slightly concave curve from the median notch toward the lobe midpoints, transitioning to a straight line towards the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of discrete dark focal spots on the medial-right lobe surface; unique jagged-edge interface between the white fluke field and the black peduncle pigmentation.
